# The Preops Clinic

> A dedicated cardiac preoperative evaluation clinic in Tarzana, California (San Fernando Valley, Los Angeles). A service of Valley Heart and Rhythm Medical, Inc. Tagline: "Quality Without the Wait."

## What the clinic does

The Preops Clinic evaluates patients who need a cardiology assessment before noncardiac surgery. Surgeons' offices, urgent cares, and primary care physicians send a referral; the clinic calls the patient to schedule, performs the evaluation (history, exam, ECG) and arranges any needed cardiac testing (echocardiogram, treadmill stress test, or imaging stress test), then sends the evaluation letter, the consult note, and the test reports to the surgeon's office by fax, with a copy to the primary care physician. If anything could affect the surgery date, the clinic calls the surgeon's office first.

Evaluations follow the 2024 ACC/AHA guideline for perioperative cardiovascular management for noncardiac surgery. Testing is ordered only when it would change the plan. The clinic is a preoperative service: patients are referred back to their usual care team (their referring physician and primary care physician) for ongoing care.

The clinic was started by Menachem Wakslak, MD, a board-certified cardiologist with fellowship training in cardiac electrophysiology who has practiced in the San Fernando Valley for more than thirteen years. He trained at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai, Maimonides Medical Center, and the University of Rochester Medical Center, and is on staff at Providence Cedars-Sinai Tarzana Medical Center and Northridge Hospital Medical Center.

## How to refer a patient (for surgeons' offices and urgent cares)

- Fax the one-page referral form, or any order, with the patient's face sheet and medication list to 818-724-8300
- Secure online referral form: https://www.preops.com/#refer
- Email: referrals@preops.com
- Call or text with questions about a referral: 818-724-8200
- Referral form (PDF): https://www.preops.com/referral-form.pdf
- HMO patients: the referral or authorization should name Menachem Wakslak, MD, Valley Heart and Rhythm Medical, Inc.

## For patients

Bring a medication list, insurance card and photo ID, and any prior heart records. The evaluation letter goes to the surgeon and the primary care doctor; patients are told exactly which medications to take or hold before surgery.

## Insurance

Currently contracted with Medicare, Blue Cross, Aetna, Cigna, Regal / Lakeside, Optum, Axminster, and Preferred IPA, with more to come. HMO patients need a referral from their primary care physician. Patients without insurance can contact the clinic for cash prices.
